title: Provider free 1-month trial
notes: Changed: new providers can start with a free 30-day trial instead of paying R200/month — a 'Free 1-Month Trial' plan sits alongside the Standard Service Provider plan on the upgrade page; selecting it skips payment details

Changed: trial applications flow through the same identity verification + admin approval review, get a green 'Free Trial' badge in the admin approvals list, then the trial clock (trial_started_at / trial_ends_at) is stamped onto the verification record on approval
Changed: the Service Provider dashboard now shows a trial status banner - days left while active, and a 'go paid R200/mo' prompt once the trial has ended
